title: Tool Consecutive Failure Alert Plugin Config

consecutive_failure_threshold.description: Consecutive failure count threshold to trigger alert

cooldown_seconds.description: Cooldown period in seconds between alerts for the same (trace, tool) pair

desensitization.description: Desensitization policy for tool parameters and results

tool_name_format.description: Tool name format in alerts: 'bare' uses only the tool name (e.g. 'ls'), 'full' uses the complete command line with arguments (e.g. 'ls /aaa'). In 'full' mode, different command arguments are tracked as separate tools.

policy_denied_counts_as_failure.description: Whether tool policy denial counts as a failure

state_ttl_seconds.description: TTL in seconds for state auto-recycling after trace ends
